drafts.angle: Principle statement (rides @sama 'People should always be in control')
drafts.draft_en:
Brands should always be in control of what AI says on their behalf.

Not the model. Not the ad platform. Not whoever hit generate at 2am.

Every AI-made ad should be checked against your brand rules, your legal team's approvals, and platform policy before it ships.
drafts.video_tip: Text-only works best here, matching @sama's format. If you want video: 8s vertical, the first line on black, then a quick montage of three AI ads stamped APPROVE / FIX / BLOCK.

drafts.draft_en:
Every line of code gets audited automatically now.

Every line of ad copy should too.

Aubric checks each claim, image, frame, and voiceover against brand rules, legal requirements, and ad-platform policy before publish, then returns approve, fix, or block.
drafts.video_tip: 15s vertical screen capture: paste an ad, watch each line light up green or red as it's checked, freeze on one red claim with the rule it broke and the suggested fix.
